scenarios.title: Display existing vendor codes and new code option on setup page
given: Existing vendor codes are registered in the system (e.g. VENDOR1, VENDOR2)
scenarios.when: The user navigates to the setup page
then: The existing vendor codes are presented as selectable options
An explicit option to enter a new vendor code is displayed

scenarios.title: Selecting new code option displays entry field on setup page
given: The user is on the setup page
scenarios.when: The user selects the option to enter a new vendor code
then: An input field for entering a new vendor code becomes available

scenarios.title: Select existing vendor code on setup page
given: The user is on the setup page with existing vendor codes displayed (e.g. VENDOR1)
scenarios.when: The user selects an existing vendor code and submits the setup form
then: The scanner setup is completed with the selected vendor code
No new vendor code is created

scenarios.title: Switch from new code entry back to existing vendor code on setup page
given: The user is on the setup page
The user selected the option to enter a new code and typed a value (e.g. TYPO123)
scenarios.when: The user switches selection to an existing vendor code (e.g. VENDOR1) and submits
then: The scanner setup is completed using the selected existing vendor code
The typed value is discarded and no new vendor code is created

scenarios.title: Enter and submit a genuine new vendor code on setup page
given: The user is on the setup page
scenarios.when: The user selects the option to enter a new vendor code, enters a new code (e.g. NEWVENDOR), and submits the setup form
then: The scanner setup is completed with the newly entered vendor code
The new vendor code is saved and appears as a selectable option in subsequent views

scenarios.title: Submit empty value for new vendor code on setup page
given: The user is on the setup page with the new vendor code option selected
scenarios.when: The user submits the setup form with the new vendor code field left blank
then: A validation message indicating that a vendor code is required is shown
The setup configuration is not updated

scenarios.title: Display existing vendor codes and new code option on scan page
given: Existing vendor codes are registered in the system (e.g. VENDOR1, VENDOR2)
scenarios.when: The user navigates to the scan page
then: The existing vendor codes are presented as selectable options
An explicit option to enter a new vendor code is displayed

scenarios.title: Selecting new code option displays entry field on scan page
given: The user is on the scan page
scenarios.when: The user selects the option to enter a new vendor code
then: An input field for entering a new vendor code becomes available

scenarios.title: Select existing vendor code on scan page
given: The user is on the scan page with existing vendor codes displayed (e.g. VENDOR1)
scenarios.when: The user selects an existing vendor code and confirms
then: The scanning session is associated with the selected vendor code
No new vendor code is created

scenarios.title: Switch from new code entry back to existing vendor code on scan page
given: The user is on the scan page
The user selected the option to enter a new code and typed a value (e.g. TYPO123)
scenarios.when: The user switches selection to an existing vendor code (e.g. VENDOR1) and confirms
then: The scanning session is associated with the selected existing vendor code
The typed value is discarded and no new vendor code is created

scenarios.title: Enter and confirm a genuine new vendor code on scan page
given: The user is on the scan page
scenarios.when: The user selects the option to enter a new vendor code, enters a new code (e.g. NEWVENDOR), and confirms
then: The scanning session is associated with the newly entered vendor code
The new vendor code is saved and appears as a selectable option in subsequent views

scenarios.title: Confirm empty value for new vendor code on scan page
given: The user is on the scan page with the new vendor code option selected
scenarios.when: The user attempts to proceed with the new vendor code field left blank
then: A validation message indicating that a vendor code is required is shown
The scanning session does not proceed
